items.computation: Appointment is Monday 14.12.2026. 'Mindestens zwei Werktage vorher' (Werktage = Mon-Sat, excluding public holidays) counted backwards from the appointment date, not counting the appointment day itself: 1 Werktag back = Saturday 12.12.2026; Sunday 13.12.2026 is not a Werktag and is skipped; 2 Werktage back = Friday 11.12.2026.
